openSource.title: Fixed #36892 -- Added LazySerializer for lazy objects in migrations.
description: Fixed a bug in Django Migrations where using lazy-evaluated tuples in model choices caused the same migration to be generated repeatedly.
Created a new 'LazySerializer' that uses Python's '__reduce__' method to correctly break down and rebuild lazy objects during serialization.
Added logic to distinguish between translatable strings (which should stay strings) and functional objects (which need to be reconstructed).
Wrote new test cases to ensure that lazy tuples, lists, and dictionaries are correctly handled by the MigrationWriter without triggering unnecessary changes.

openSource.title: Fixed #36835 -- Added all public API classes to django.template.__all__.
description: Refactored the django.template namespace to define its public API using __all__, removing the need for redundant # NOQA markers.
Cleaned up imports by removing unnecessary isort:skip tags, making it easier for IDEs to provide accurate suggestions.

openSource.title: Fixed #36894 -- Added TypeError for conflicting arguments in mail APIs.
description: Refactored core email APIs to enforce strict argument validation, preventing silent failures when conflicting parameters were provided.
Implemented explicit TypeError raises across the django.core.mail module to improve developer debugging and API consistency.
Developed exhaustive test suites using unittest.subTest to validate keyword arguments and ensured backward compatibility.
Authored technical documentation for the Django 6.1 release detailing API best practices.

openSource.title: Blocked set_clim() callbacks to prevent inconsistent state (#29522)
description: Fixed a bug in Matplotlib where updating color limits (vmin/vmax) caused the plot colors to break when a colorbar was present.
Identified that updating the minimum and maximum values separately was triggering 'changed' signals too early, putting the plot in an invalid state.
Used a 'callbacks.blocked' context manager to pause updates until both limits were correctly set, ensuring the UI only refreshes once.
Added a new test using mocks to confirm that exactly one update signal is sent, preventing unnecessary re-renders and potential crashes.
